exposure: maternal use of folic acid (FA) during pregnancy
FA dosages at first and third trimester of pregnancy (< 1000, 1000-4999, and >= 5000 ug/day)
outcome: child anthropometric measures at birth (weight, length, head circumference)
Small for gestational age according to weight (SGA-w)
Small for gestational age according to length (SGA-l)
Small for gestational age according to head circumference (SGA-hc)
cohort: The study included 2302 mother-child pairs from a population-based birth cohort in Spain (INMA Project).
finding: High dosages of folic acid (>= 1000 ug/day) during the periconceptional period may be associated with an increased risk of small for gestational age according to weight (SGA-w) at birth.
birth_weight: Weight in grams was measured, but no specific range for inclusion was mentioned.
gest_age: Small for gestational age was an outcome, but no specific gestational age range for inclusion was mentioned.
